requirements.requirement: The system must execute unit tests that validate prescription schema compliance against the defined MongoDB contract.
The system must verify that valid sample ingestion records pass schema validation without errors.
The system must fail unit tests when required schema fields (e.g., NPI, drug identifier) are missing.
The system must validate that ingestion logic correctly maps prescriber identifiers to NPI values.
The system must validate that drug identifiers are correctly mapped to condition taxonomy using ICD10 loader outputs.
The system must verify that normalized metrics (e.g., claim counts) are correctly transformed from raw CMS data.
The system must execute integration tests that persist transformed prescription records to MongoDB PublicHealthData.prescriptions.
The system must verify that persisted MongoDB documents match the expected structure and values after ingestion.
The system must validate idempotent behavior by ensuring duplicate ingestion runs do not create duplicate records.
The system must execute tests using existing pipeline_worker_base test patterns.
The system must execute SIT tests using gpt_sit_runner to validate end-to-end ingestion workflow.
The system must validate integration with GPT reader test patterns where applicable.
The system must fail integration tests when MongoDB connection is unavailable or misconfigured.
The system must fail ingestion tests when transformation logic produces null or invalid condition taxonomy mappings.
The system must produce deterministic test results across repeated runs with identical input data.
